bestTimeToVisit.title: Shoulder seasons are typically easiest in St. Augustine
bullets: Spring and fall usually offer comfortable weather and smoother logistics.
Reserve popular tours and timed attractions early in busy periods.
Use morning starts for major sights and photo-heavy locations.

travelTips: Group activities by area to reduce transfers across St. Augustine.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for St. Augustine?
faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core St. Augustine highlights plus one or two local experiences.

faq.q: Should I book tours ahead in St. Augustine?
faq.a: Yes—advance booking is recommended for weekends, holidays, and top-rated operators.
